From report to action in one hour

takeaways: Read threat analytics reports down to the MITRE ATT&CK mapping and the organization-specific exposure panel instead of skimming the overview.
Turn each report recommendation into a Secure Score control with an owner, an SLA and evidence of effectiveness.
Hunt the listed techniques, join findings to incidents, verify controls by rerunning the queries and track time to detect and closed attack paths.
hook: Most security teams skim Microsoft Defender threat analytics reports and miss the parts that actually close attack paths. This episode gives SOC analysts and security admins a repeatable one-hour routine: read, test, act, verify. You learn how to link reports to hunting queries, incidents and Secure Score controls and to measure time to detect.
